Migrated from canardlapin/scalafim Mote bd-01KY5P1XX2K8ABTNQP9VDXHDHQ on 2026-08-01 after HalfFlow ownership moved to canardlapin/reframe4s.
Source status: open. Source created_at: 2026-07-22T19:50:15.714724Z.

Freeze the experiment before implementation. Extract sparse correspondences every approximately 8 mm from the existing same-affine ANTs deformation and define synthetic translation, rotation, affine-background, regional-residual, outlier, and boundary fixtures.

Required lanes: oracle correspondences to bridge; oracle correspondences to bridge to frozen HalfFlow budget2x; current block correspondences to bridge to frozen HalfFlow budget2x.

Acceptance: document coordinate frames and p-q tangent sign with the existing translation oracle; record ANTs as an engineering oracle rather than ground truth; hold labels and evaluation masks out of matching and assimilation; predeclare match-error, CC, Dice, Jacobian, inverse/export, runtime, and support measurements; preserve identical affine and native pyramids across lanes; emit deterministic fixture hashes and a lane manifest. Stop if oracle correspondences cannot be expressed unambiguously in midpoint work coordinates.
set.title: BasinBridge B0: freeze oracle decomposition and fixtures
